answer_1.quote: Focusing on an open-ended auto-regressive text generation task, they show that it is possible to exploit the contrast between the predictions of the expert and amateur to obtain an improved generated output.

answer_2.quote: Generation quality is evaluated using automatic metrics focusing on different axes: aggregated ngram diversity measures the repetitiveness within the generated continuations; semantic coherence estimates topic drift by calculating similarity between the prompt and continuation.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation of a sample of generation outputs from the results in Table , presenting the prompt and pairs of generated texts to human annotators and asking them to compare the quality of outputs.
answer_4.guideline: For each instance, they were asked to select the better model on 3 different aspects, in separate questions: fluency, coherence and overall quality.
